name: conch_trumpet
character: A conch-shell trumpet: one long, hoarse, low blast that swells in and bends up a little, like a distant horn from inside the temple.
sources: Maya conch-shell trumpets are documented in Classic Maya art and burials: https://flaar-mesoamerica.org/research-reports/musical-instruments-of-the-classic-maya-and-teotihuacan/ and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maya_music
Zalaquett et al. (2023), Ancient Mesoamerica: archaeoacoustical study of instruments from Comalcalco and Jonuta https://cambridge.org/core/product/634568408B4CB1F801829BB8C9CBFA4C/core-reader
ESTIMATE: f0 170-235 Hz, length and swell are not measured; no recording of a conch was analysed here
